name: What is full-body circuit training?
description: Full-body circuit training is a workout method where you perform multiple exercises targeting different muscle groups consecutively with short rest periods.

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-body circuit training involves a series of exercises performed one after another with minimal rest between them, targeting various muscle groups across the entire body. Once all exercises in the circuit are completed, a short rest period is taken before repeating the circuit. This method is efficient for improving both strength and cardiovascular fitness simultaneously. At Cave Training, our full-body circuit training is designed to maximize your workout time, offering a comprehensive session that challenges different parts of your body in one efficient visit.
